publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.1.3 is an unpublished candidate adopting rer 0.2.2 recovery. Deployment migration history remains installation-local and is checked before transfer; genuine bound archives retain product history while restored monitors are paused, destinations disabled and notification work inactive. Unbound archives from Uptime 0.1.2 and earlier still require re-export from the upgraded source installation. This candidate does not establish hosted operation or screen-reader acceptance.
